connect.ecosystem.intro: Drlisabelisle.com is the personal hub. The work itself lives across these companion sites, each with its own rhythm and audience.
read.bp.desc: Two essays a week, organized around four pillars: story, system, self, and seasonality. The Bountiful Path is the writing home — longer pieces, lighter pieces, and recurring features that take the work into the week and the year.
about.hero.lede: Three decades of medicine, a parallel life in writing and broadcasting, and the family that made it all possible.
home.pullquote: How we live matters as much as how long we live.
home.doors.read.desc: The Bountiful Path on Substack, books in progress, and tools that turn the writing into practice.
listen.hero.lede: Radio Maine is a video podcast where Maine’s artists, healers, writers, and community leaders talk about the work of being human.
read.memoir.desc: A memoir centered on Lisa’s relationship with her late father, Charles Belisle, MD, who practiced for nearly fifty years at Maine Medical Center’s Family Medicine Residency Program. The book moves through clinical practice, childhood, and the particular inheritance of being raised by a country doctor.
connect.hero.lede: Speaking inquiries, press and interview requests, course or toolkit questions, or just to say hello.
home.doors.join.desc: Live panels, gallery evenings, and virtual book circles. Where to be in the room with Lisa.
read.hero.lede: If a line on Substack stayed with you, this is where the writing comes from — and what to read next.
home.doors.listen.desc: Radio Maine: a video podcast of conversations with Maine’s artists, healers, and community leaders.
invite.intro: Lisa has presented at national medical conferences and cultural gatherings on the intersections of medicine, creativity, leadership, and seasonal wellbeing. Her talks draw on more than three decades of clinical experience, training in Chinese medicine and Five Phase theory, and the stories that emerge when medicine and art share a room. She brings the ear of a clinician, the pace of a broadcaster, and the attention of a writer.
invite.hero.lede: Looking for a keynote, fireside, workshop, or retreat? Here’s what Lisa speaks on, where she’s been, and how to reach her.
home.doors.invite.desc: Keynotes, fireside conversations, workshops, and panel moderation. Topics, past venues, and how to reach Lisa.
join.hero.lede: Live panels, gallery evenings, and virtual book circles — the gatherings where the writing and the conversations come into a room together.
listen.rm.desc: Lisa hosts conversations with Maine’s artists, healers, physicians, writers, and community leaders. Episodes are filmed in partnership with the Portland Art Gallery and released weekly. The Bountiful Path series is a sub-channel devoted to longer-form pieces tied to the newsletter.
